name: AI Inbox Assistant — Gmail + Gemini + MCP + Confidence Gate
description: Gmail API → Sheets API (RAG-lite knowledge base) → Gemini API (MCP) → Router: Confidence Gate → Gmail Draft or Telegram Escalation
modules: Google Sheets: Get Knowledge Base (Sheets API - RAG-lite)
Gemini: Generate Text (Gemini API + MCP + LangChain)
Router: Confidence ≥80% → Gmail Draft, <80% → Telegram Alert
note: Knowledge base: 10 Q&As in Google Sheet. Prompt: 'You are support for [Company]. Knowledge: [KB]. Answer email: {{text}}. If not in KB, say EXACTLY: ESCALATE. Output: ANSWER: [text] | CONFIDENCE: [%]'
